closure_findings.subject: Satay by the Bay, Gardens by the Bay #01-19
closure_findings.current_source_delta: Official notice previously captured says venue closes from Oct 1 for a refreshed waterfront dining experience; current official dine-and-shop directory no longer lists Satay by the Bay. Current SFA Track Records still returns both exact licence IDs and address, but has no active-status field.
closure_findings.classification: venue closed / successor concept planned; permanent cessation of named licensed establishment and status of the individual stall tenants are not explicitly resolved by the current sources.
closure_findings.removal_recommendation: none; do not delete exact rows until permanent cessation of each establishment is explicit or exact tenant-to-row closure is confirmed.

closure_findings.subject: Lao Liang, Berseh Food Centre
closure_findings.match_basis: Exact business name Lao Liang and official SFA address 166 Jalan Besar stall 037; matches Berseh Food Centre #02-37 in published closure reporting.
closure_findings.status: reported final service 2026-10-31; date is in the future as of 2026-10-19. Current SFA record still returns same name/address but provides no current-operating-status field.
closure_findings.source_quality: recent reporting attributes the closure to direct owner interview, but no first-party operator or official mall/landlord closure notice located in this pass.
closure_findings.removal_recommendation: none before effective date; recheck after 2026-10-31 against direct/official evidence.

closure_findings.subject: London Grill Japanese & Western, First Centre
closure_findings.review: recent reporting identifies an upcoming 2026-10-31 closure at First Centre, but no exact London Grill row. The one blank-name First Centre row at #01-30 is CE26I73L000; SFA identifies its licensee as CHOO'S WOK 2 and businessName NA, so it cannot be mapped to London Grill. Do not remove.

closure_findings.subject: OldTown White Coffee, Kallang Wave Mall
closure_findings.review: recent reports say last Singapore outlet closed 2026-10-11; no OldTown name or Kallang Wave address row matching this outlet was found in the workbook. No removal candidate.

closure_findings.subject: Hoshino Coffee, United Square / Chinatown Point
closure_findings.review: current Hoshino official location page lists both outlet addresses while recent closure reporting says they closed in Aug 2026; workbook contains no Hoshino row at either address. Conflicting source status and no exact row: no deletion.

decision: No workbook edits. No exact permanent closure is established by current authoritative evidence at the row/licence level. Keep rows pending stronger evidence; SFA Track Records response presence and past-year suspension are not licence-currentness or closure proof.
